inbox-ui.manifest_template:
name = "inbox-ui-acceptor"
version = "0.1.0"
package = "__PACKAGE__"
initial_state = '{"bearer_token":"__BEARER_TOKEN__","basic_auth":"__BASIC_AUTH__","api_base_url":"__API_BASE_URL__","ui_handler_manifest":"__UI_HANDLER_MANIFEST__"}'
[[handler]]
type = "runtime"
[[handler]]
type = "tcp"
[[handler]]
type = "supervisor"
[[handler]]
type = "rpc"
[[handler]]
type = "store"
base_path = "/mnt/main-volume/inbox/store"
store_id = "inbox"

tickets-ui.manifest_template:
name = "tickets-ui"
version = "0.1.0"
package = "__PACKAGE__"
static_package = true
initial_state = '{"api_addr":"127.0.0.1:8443","api_token":"__API_TOKEN__","listen_addr":"127.0.0.1:9444"}'
[[handler]]
type = "runtime"
[[handler]]
type = "tcp"
